name: Sahara Housing Fina Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Sahara Housing Fina Corporation Ltd is in the business of providing Housing Finance in India[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
a) Home Loan:[2]
Loans are provided for purchase of Flat / Bungalow / Apartment, Construction of houses, Repairs, Renovation & Extension of Property, Loan take over from another HFC/Bank
b) Mortgage Loan Scheme:[3]
This is provided on 50% of the market value of the property to meet immediate requirements like children’s education, marriage, etc.
c) NRP Loan Scheme:[4]
This loan is for professionals like practicing Medicos, CA/ICWA/CS, Architect, Consulting Engineer, Solicitors to acquire/ construct office premises or clinic etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.63 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -9.95% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.27% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
